curved_spacing_pair.controlled_variables: same point count, row count, thickness, SubD level, shading policy, and approximate circular base surface; only column spacing changes
curved_spacing_pair.interpretation: The candidate count alone points the wrong way. Median curvature variation, maximum outlier severity, topology wire, and the fixed top-view highlight support the uneven-spacing failure.

boundary_flow_pair.interpretation: A local continuous perimeter ring materially improves the sloped boundary highlight, but costs about three times the evaluated faces. Use it where the reference requires that sharper perimeter; it is not free detail.

loop_termination_pair.controlled_variables: same 21 vertices, 13 connected quads, Bend angle, Solidify thickness, SubD level, shading, and presentation; only one reduction vertex position changes
loop_termination_pair.interpretation: Counts and candidate totals again fail to identify the defect. The base wire reveals the inward/concave reduction and fixed MatCap reveals its concentrated crease; the safe convex pattern preserves a broad continuous highlight.

claim_boundary: Metrics are candidate evidence interpreted with fixed-frame MatCap and wire renders. They do not prove universal perceptual quality.
